data.title: Only 15% of Israelis believe Israel won war with Iran, survey finds | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: The majority of respondents to a recent INSS survey did not believe Israel emerged as the clear victor in the war against Iran, with 43% saying the war ended without a decisive outcome.
